editorial_coverage.method: Inspect lowest rated preferred shelves, structural-warning clusters, known factual backlog, high-rated everyday negative controls, old sparse challenge routes, first eight and last eight exploration recipes. Editorial sample was purposive, not random or statistical.

editorial_findings.issue: Four C3 thin targets, four interacting Conexiuni predicate/mirror defects, three quick explanations with a non-Latin member under a Latin predicate.
Twelve eligible live sparse challenges have a single productive opening.
Three inaccurate descriptions, three stale active-career verbs, one false high-strength casting edge. Metadata correction alone does not promote any rejected board.

Type-homogeneous groups make categorical sorting visible; easier than implied normal difficulty. No concrete competing partition proven here. Keep in review pool pending human difficulty evidence, not automatic removal.

Repeated groups/reskins reduce variety. Exact board freshness matters, but warnings alone do not establish factual invalidity or multiple defensible solutions. Preserve unless an explicit novelty retirement is reviewed.
Broad culture/meme and mirrored warning cases need fresh mixed-age recognition observations and tighter predicates. Sample flags remain proposals, not a declaration that all are unfair.

Low salience of Meglenoromână and Avocatul Poporului is a proxy warning, not evidence of non-recognition. Deep linguistic target is a priority for a real familiarity test; no false factual assertion was established.

Most sampled old route captions remain generic legătură directă; lt_limba_033 alternatives Regionalisme/Grai are largely taxonomy, and low-salience endpoints alone do not establish unfairness. Improve exact neutral captions and measure first-hop understanding before broad removal.

Latest two dishes are terminal. More onward uses may deepen exploration, but terminal discoveries are not a correctness defect; five concept slots remain. Existing explanations name actual preparation/additional ingredients and avoid implying every two-input pair is a complete literal recipe.

negative_controls.reason: Despite low salience/generic source-graph warnings, live sparse recipes remain bounded with 8/5/4 openings; no reserve proposed.

Cacao to Lapte gives two recognizable culinary alternatives with four qualified captions. Existing source graph permits five directions; do not invent absent reverse links or drop ingredient-variant qualifications.

Electrical connection pieces, water-connected sanitary items, floor-cleaning tools and rail transport have understandable strict functions with a distinct outsider. Machine same-type gate is supplemented by actual semantic reading.

Concrete familiar pairs have a plausible dominant matching (ankle/leg, sink/tap, hammer/nail, thirst/water, etc.). Semantic competing-pair search did not reveal a second equally defensible complete matching in these sampled boards.
Latin alphabet/Latin/Romanian trio lacks Dacian substrate; preserve independently of the defective sibling trio.

limits: No review status, runtime, or fixture mutation
A numeric score or valid KG edge does not prove semantic quality
All proposed exclusions and repairs require separate independent quality/factual review before installation
No claim that every one of 2416 descriptions, every semantic pair, or every default/mined fallback has received fresh editorial verification.
Full API/UI and integrated regression checks are owned by the root release task; this audit covers stock data, exact runtime projection/closure, and finite editorial samples.
